page.layout: One printed page: page number top left; running head "EMBLEMA" with title "FAMA MALVM! QVO non aliud." centred at head; a woodcut engraving in the middle; a four-line verse below the picture, centred; a catchword-like word "Sunt," at the lower right margin.

main_text.l: [woodcut engraving: a winged-sail female figure standing on a fish-like boat with a goat-legged figure; no text]
Ecce rotantur res hominum, suprema labascunt,
Et quem suscipiunt speciosa cacumina fam-
Altius, hoc amens altius ipse cadet.

page.notes: The woodcut is an engraving of an allegorical figure (Fama) standing on a boat/fish with a satyr-like figure; described, not transcribed. The word "Sunt," at the lower right is printed as a signature-like or catchword mark and is given as a foot line. The title line is set in italic capitals with a mixed-size rendering; "FAMA MALVM!" reads as printed.
